title_zh: 确认嘉宾先致辞并提前到场

scenario.label_zh: 核对开幕致辞顺序与嘉宾到场
scenario.goal_zh: 确认欢迎致辞在合唱前进行，并约定嘉宾提前到门厅与主持人会合

context_zh: 社区中心开幕式前，主持人与受邀嘉宾核对流程。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: Will my welcome speech come before or after the choir?

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: It will precede the first song. I'd like to introduce you while everyone is seated.

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: Then I'll arrive early rather than slip in just before the performance.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Thank you. Your presence means a lot to the volunteers who restored this place.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: In the foyer at half past six. I'll walk you to the front row.

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: Half past six in the foyer. I'll be there.
